blocks.text: SACRAMENTO, California— Stephon Castle had 28 points, 11 assists and eight rebounds as the San Antonio Spurs beat the Sacramento Kings 123-107 in the NBA on Monday night without Victor Wembanyama and other key starters. Wembanyama sat out with back tightness after posting 50 points and 19 rebounds Saturday in a 114-91 win over New Orleans. De’Aaron Fox (shin) and Dylan Harper (hip) were also ruled out against Sacramento, yet the Spurs shook off a sluggish start and improved to 8-0 on the road.
